# M2-3: Transaction read tools

- Milestone: M2
- Branch / worktree: `t/M2-3`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M2-3`
- Depends on: M2-2
- Touches (exclusive while running): mcp/ (new files `tools_transactions*.go`), store/ (read queries in a new file)
- Plan refs: §2 split handling, §4 tools, R9
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no

## Goal
Both spouses can ask about spending: `query_transactions(filter)` and `compare_spending(period, baseline)`. Code does the
arithmetic and dates, and answers cite transactions and freshness.

## Scope
- `query_transactions`: filters for date range, account, category, payee text, amount range, approved state; bounded page
  size with a cursor; returned rows carry transaction ids so answers can cite them.
- `compare_spending`: per-category totals for a period against a baseline period, with the difference.
- Split handling: category reads and totals use `subtransactions`, never the split parent's sentinel category. Deleted
  rows are excluded. Milliunits become exact decimal strings.
- Payee and memo text are returned as data; descriptions tell the model so (§6 prompt injection).

- Add tools with `register(auth.ScopeMCP, &sdkmcp.Tool{...}, handler)` from an `init` in a new file; the handler returns only its data and the `Response[T]` wrapper adds freshness. There's no way yet to send a client a specific error such as a bad filter, so add it next to `errTool` in this task.

## Out of scope
- Snapshot, tags and goals (M2-4). `get_category_decisions` (M3), `get_tithing_status`, `get_fun_money` (M4).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Tests over a fixture DB: split transactions are counted once under their child categories, deleted rows are absent,
      refunds net correctly, period boundaries are inclusive and in the plan's dates.
- [ ] Test: page size is capped; cursor paging returns each row exactly once.
- [ ] Test: both tools include data freshness.
- [ ] `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` green
